cohort: The study included 111 full-term and 111 preterm infants who were followed and assessed in their first year of life.
finding: Preterm infants showed higher incidences of gross motor (31%), fine motor (30.1%), problem-solving (14.2%), and personal-social disorders (12.4%) based on the Ages and Stages Questionnaire.
gest_age: Preterm and full-term infants were included, with gestational age showing a statistically significant correlation with contracting.
